scanWindow: Since the 2026-08-31 completed scan, plus material missed developments from the previous 48 hours
notes: Completed the 2026-09-01 editorial scan. Published two Daily Briefs. Anthropic's August 31 security/alignment update is Must know because it documents concrete post-incident changes to evaluation containment, monitoring, partner requirements and training-environment quality controls, while clearly marking its alignment conclusions as preliminary. Reuters independently confirms that external cyber evaluations resumed after the pause. Google's August 31 Antigravity Teamwork update is Must know as a durable multi-agent orchestration signal: Google documents parallel strategy search, critique, decomposition and self-verification across mathematics, systems and open-source engineering, and links public papers/code artifacts; benchmark and performance claims remain framed as vendor evidence. The reported NVIDIA acquisition of Hugging Face remains Watch because no matching NVIDIA or Hugging Face primary announcement was established. Reuters reporting on a large Anthropic-Lambda cloud agreement is not published because the named companies did not publicly confirm it. NIST's August 28 agent-identity guidance scored Worth knowing but was not published in this run because it falls outside the freshest window and is guidance rather than a new standard or binding control. A new harness-evolution preprint is interesting but remains Watch pending broader evidence and durability. Existing Aug 27-31 stories were deduplicated; rumours, unsupported rankings, unverified pricing and recycled launch coverage were skipped.
